Package in.co.rays.proj4.bean

Class RoleBean

java.lang.Object
in.co.rays.proj4.bean.BaseBean
in.co.rays.proj4.bean.RoleBean
All Implemented Interfaces:
DropDownListBean
public class RoleBean extends BaseBean
RoleBean is a JavaBean class that represents a Role entity. It is used to handle records of the role table. This class contains role related attributes such as name and description. It also defines constants for predefined roles like Admin, Student, College, Kiosk and Faculty. It extends BaseBean to inherit common properties like id, createdBy, etc.
